title: InTruth launches AI tool for real-time political fact #InTruth #politicalfactcheck #aitechnology
description: InTruth launched an AI tool that catches politicians lying in real time. By converting speech to text during live debates or interviews, it verifies claims instantly, providing sources and nuanced fact-checking like misleading or unverifiable. This Chrome extension enhances political accountability by displaying evidence directly on screen as politicians speak, helping viewers discern facts before misinformation spreads. While AI won't eliminate falsehoods, it empowers people with immediate access to truth in political discourse. InTruth represents a significant step toward transparency in media and politics, leveraging AI to transform how information is consumed and verified during live events. #InTruth #AIfactchecking #politicalaccountability #livetruthverification #Chromeextension #AIforgood #medialiteracy #politicsandtechnology #misinformation #factcheckAI #realTimeFactCheck #digitaltransparency #aitechnology #truthinpolitics #debateverification
